context_image.usage_description: The left 128x128 area is the unchanged source sheet. The 64x64 sprite on the right guides only the appearance of the requested addition, never the body pose.

parameters.description: Edit the four existing south-facing poses in this 2x2 sheet. In each 64x64 cell add only the same steel sailor sword shown by the right-side reference, attached to the existing right hand, blade angled down-left. Keep identical blade length, width, brass guard, palette and pixel scale across cells. Preserve every body pixel, pose, cell position and transparency. No other objects or anatomy.
